card.name: Casual web-writing connector words
card.fires_on: Common short words in chatty web text, such as can, miss, back, for, at and never. They sit in friendly or promotional phrases where a stock phrase is likely to continue.

modes.label: Casual blog phrasing
modes.description: Words in conversational remarks, such as thanks for the comment or never mind.

modes.label: Mid-sentence verbs and modifiers
modes.description: Short verbs or adjectives that continue a general explanation, such as can also or a perfect tool.
